item.text: I have the key rationale and the precision constraints. I’m grabbing the exact entry titles now so I can cite them cleanly in the answer.

CodeGraph emits value-reference edges to make impact analysis see dependency reachability from file-scope constants, configs, and lookup tables to the symbols that actually read them, because call/import/inheritance edges miss that change-impact class (“Value-reader impact reachability”). It keeps them precise by only emitting same-file `references` edges, gating targets by shared-scope parent kinds, and only matching reads with a static identifier and exact `valueRef` metadata rather than broad pattern matches (“Additive value-ref emission”, “Default-on value refs”).
